SSAquaCaptainExhaustingText:
Whew! Thanks for
coming along.

Keeping that lit-
tle girl amused was exhausting.
SSAquaCaptainHowDoYouLikeText:
How do you like
S.S.AQUA's ride?

She practically
skates across the waves.
SSAquaCantFindGranddaughterText:
Oh, hello…

I still can't find
my granddaughter.

If she's on the
ship, that's OK.

She's an energetic
child, so she may

be bugging some-
one. I'm worried…
SSAquaEntertainedGranddaughterText:
, was it?
I heard you enter- tained my grand- daughter.

I want to thank
you for that.
SSAquaGrandpaHaveThisText:
I know! I'd like
you to have this!
SSAquaGranddaughterCaptainPlayWithMeText:
CAPTAIN, play with
me, please?

I'm bored! I want
to play more!
SSAquaGranddaughterHasToFindGrandpaText:
Hi! Will you play
with me?

…Oh!

Grandpa's worried
about me?

I have to go!

I have to go find
Grandpa!
SSAquaGranddaughterWasPlayingMText:
Grandpa, here I
am! I was playing

with the CAPTAIN
and this guy!
SSAquaGranddaughterWasPlayingFText:
Grandpa, here I
am! I was playing

with the CAPTAIN
and this big girl!
SSAquaGranddaughterHadFunText:
I had lots of fun
playing!
PokefanmColinSeenText:
Hey, kid! Want to
battle with me?
PokefanmColinAfterBattleText:
You're traveling
all alone?

Isn't your mom
worried?
TwinsMegandpeg1SeenText:
You think I'm a
baby? That's not fair!
TwinsMegandpeg1AfterBattleText:
Baby is a rude
name to call us girls!
TwinsMegandpeg2SeenText:
I'm not a baby!

That's not nice to
say to a lady!
TwinsMegandpeg2AfterBattleText:
Sometimes, kids
are smarter than grown-ups!
PsychicRodneySeenText:
Ssh! My brain is
picking up radio signals!
PsychicRodneyAfterBattleText:
I get it. You can
hear JOHTO's radio on the FAST SHIP.
PokefanmJeremySeenText:
What do you think?
My #MON are beautiful, yes?
PokefanmJeremyAfterBattleText:
I must go to the
#MON SALON and fix them up nice!
PokefanfGeorgiaSeenText:
I'm going to shop
at the DEPT.STORE and then…
PokefanfGeorgiaBeatenText:
What was I going
to do?
PokefanfGeorgiaAfterBattleText:
Oh, yes! I have to
get my #MON out of DAY-CARE!
SupernerdShawnSeenText:
What kinds of #
BALLS do you have with you?
SupernerdShawnAfterBattleText:
You should use the
right BALLS to fit the situation.
SSAquaHasArrivedVermilionText:
FAST SHIP S.S.AQUA
has arrived in VERMILION CITY.
